title: [C#] System.Xml.Serialization XmlSerializer doesn't work, even with Microsoft.XmlSerializer.Generator
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible in v4.6.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 265KF (20 threads) - 31.62 GiB memory

### Issue description

System.Xml.Serialization XmlSerializer doesn't work in Godot since it's not unloading-friendly.
Generating a separate assembly with Microsoft.XmlSerializer.Generator (which makes it unloading-friendly) works very randomly (intermittent bug).



Most of the time, it doesn't find the assembly :

```
E 0:00:00:646   bool Microsoft.Xml.Serialization.GeneratedAssembly.XmlSerializerContract.CanSerialize(System.Type): System.IO.FileNotFoundException: Could not load file or assembly 'TestXml, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null'. The system cannot find the file specified.
  <C++ Error>   System.IO.FileNotFoundException
  <C++ Source>  :0 @ bool Microsoft.Xml.Serialization.GeneratedAssembly.XmlSerializerContract.CanSerialize(System.Type)
  <Stack Trace> :0 @ bool Microsoft.Xml.Serialization.GeneratedAssembly.XmlSerializerContract.CanSerialize(System.Type)
                :0 @ bool Microsoft.Xml.Serialization.GeneratedAssembly.XmlSerializerContract.CanSerialize(System.Type)
                :0 @ System.Reflection.Assembly System.Xml.Serialization.TempAssembly.LoadGeneratedAssembly(System.Type, string, System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializerImplementation&)
                :0 @ System.Xml.Serialization.XmlSerializer..ctor(System.Type, string)
                TestNode.cs:18 @ void TestXml.TestNode._Ready()
                Node.cs:2646 @ bool Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                TestXml.TestNode_ScriptMethods.generated.cs:40 @ bool TestXml.TestNode.InvokeGodotClassMethod(Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name&, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                CSharpInstanceBridge.cs:24 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(nint, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_string_name*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant_call_error*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)
```

Sometimes by cleaning, rebuilding, reloading editor, it works, but then changing something else in the code and rebuilding makes it break again.

### Steps to reproduce

MRP uploaded.
Just build & run, and get the same error.

It parses a xml file and tries to deserialize using a class generated with xscgen from a .xsd file.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-xml.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27430894/test-xml.zip)
